title: gregCore mod.json
description: Manifest for a gregCore Lua script mod (UserData/gregCore/Mods/<lang>/<modId>/mod.json).

id.description: Unique lowercase mod id (usually the folder name). Required.

name.description: Display name shown in the Mod Hub.

entry.description: Entry script relative to the mod folder (default: main.lua).

min_framework_version.description: Minimum gregCore version this mod was built against.
